subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should this cumulative durable-core stack be backported onto the already-shipped `release/2026.7.1` line, or retargeted to main/a future release after exact-head upgrade and generation-boundary proof?
rationale: The code review can assess the handoff mechanics, but it cannot decide whether a new persisted runtime, environment-controlled feature, protocol surface, and startup behavior belong in a shipped release branch.

options.title: Retarget to a future release
options.body: Move the ordered stack to main or the next release line and require exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, reset, and restart proof before landing.

options.title: Sponsor the 2026.7.1 backport
options.body: Keep the release target only with explicit ownership of the cumulative compatibility surface and release-grade upgrade validation.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Leave the stack unmerged until maintainers confirm the durable runtime product boundary and release schedule.

recommendation.title: Retarget to a future release
recommendation.body: Move the ordered stack to main or the next release line and require exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, reset, and restart proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the session-delivery queue and startup recovery seam used by the proposed handoff.
